verdict.rationale: Kit's pricing page lists A/B testing of subject lines and content as a product feature, so the core testing capability is first-party. The evidence is limited to pricing-page bullet points, with no documentation of how variants are set up or how a winner is chosen. Per-broadcast engagement stats exist, but they do not show automated winner selection. Missing for 10: documented automatic winner selection based on opens or clicks, details on test configuration (split size, test duration, winning metric), and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can A/B test subject lines or content variants and have the winner picked from real engagement
